description: UI modernization pass - Batch 4: Notifications, Payments, and Reports pages. Apply the premium design system. Only change CSS classes - no logic/structure changes.
steps: In src/routes/_authenticated/notifications.tsx: (1) Change page container from 'p-4 md:p-8' to 'p-5 md:p-10'. (2) On filter Buttons, add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (3) On Card, add 'shadow-sm'. (4) On each notification item (p-4 flex gap-3 hover:bg-muted/30), change to 'p-4 flex gap-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-accent/20 hover:shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (5) On icon circles (size-9 rounded-full), add 'shadow-sm'. (6) On Badge components, add 'rounded-full'. (7) On 'Done' Buttons, add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (8) Make subtitle/timestamp text use 'text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/70' where applicable.

In src/routes/_authenticated/payments.tsx: (1) Change page container from 'p-4 md:p-8' to 'p-5 md:p-10'. (2) On KPI cards (Card with gradient), add 'shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 ease-out rounded-xl'. (3) On the main payments Card, add 'shadow-sm'. (4) On each payment item (p-4 flex flex-wrap), add 'rounded-xl hover:bg-accent/20 hover:shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (5) On search Input, add 'focus:ring-2 ring-primary/20 transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (6) On StatusBadge components, add 'rounded-full'. (7) Make metadata text (booking codes, plan names) use 'text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/70'.

In src/routes/_authenticated/reports.tsx: (1) Change page container from 'p-4 md:p-8' to 'p-5 md:p-10'. (2) On KPI Cards (KpiLink component), add 'shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 ease-out rounded-xl'. (3) On report section Cards (ReportCard), add 'shadow-sm'. (4) On the global filters Card, add 'shadow-sm'. (5) On all Buttons (CSV, PDF, Email schedules), add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (6) On Inputs (date fields), add 'focus:ring-2 ring-primary/20 transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (7) On Badge components, add 'rounded-full'. (8) Make subtitle/period text use 'text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/70' where applicable.
